title: 1981-04-16_Pat_173.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a sustained metaphysical argument that his 2-3-74 visionary experience revealed a fifth-dimensional hypertime, which he identifies with Plotinian emanation and Christian Logos theology. He claims direct communication with non-human entities (the Plasmate, VALIS) who exist in this 5D realm, and argues that this 5D world represents the Pleroma, the Kingdom of God, and the realm of eternal Forms where Christ and Logos are identical. Normal time becomes spatial 'temporal parallaxis,' permitting simultaneous access to what appears separate in 4D space-time.
key_claims: The 2-3-74 vision introduced a fifth dimension (temporal parallaxis) that reveals the true structure of reality beyond our four-dimensional perception.
In 5D hypertime, common constituents unite what appear as separate temporal/spatial locations in 4D; this is how the Eucharist, sacred objects, and Christ's simultaneous presence work.
VALIS and the Plasmate are non-biological entities existing in 5D hyperspace who communicate through color, mathematical ratios, and music—a non-verbal lingua franca.
The 5D realm is identical with Plotinus' higher realm of emanation, the Platonic Pleroma where souls recover unfallen knowledge of the Forms.
Christ is both person and realm (Kosmos Noetos); entry into the 5D world through grace grants access to eternity and the Kingdom of God, collapsing the illusion of separation.
Self-authenticating information and cypher source verification proved that external non-human intelligences were communicating with PKD, not intrapsychic phenomena.

tensions: PKD oscillates between describing 5D entities as plural ('they') and singular ('one only exists'): is VALIS one being or many?
Uncertainty about whether 5D beings are 'incorporeal' or possess physicality, just unperceived by 4D consciousness.
The claim that contact is certain ('self-authenticating') yet PKD doesn't remember the detailed contents of the sequences sent.
Tension between radical otherness of 5D intelligences and their role as tutelary spirits/angels guiding human history.
PKD asserts Plotinus 'was right' about emanation yet claims his own experience goes beyond what ancient philosophy articulated.
The question of whether 5D entities deliberately hide from us or simply exist outside our perceptual range.
Untested claim: does compassion at return from 5D vision necessarily follow, or is this speculative extrapolation from literary precedent (Dante, Tagore)?
evidence_quotes: My 5D World is reassent of the soul, both in Platonist and neo-platonist terms (Valis as Plotinus' the One; continuum, etc.). My 5D realm is indeed and a fortiori another world and it is the pleroma.

For 60 seconds last night I was in direct two-way contact with them, upon my figuring out that there is such a thing as 'self-authenticating' information. At once I asked for what I call 'cypher source verification' + got several, fired very fast, mostly sequences (as are the Fibonacci numbers).
The transubstantiation of our world by Logos into the body of the Lord' that I saw Valis (Christ) doing, is that realm, of which ours is a mere 4D atomized copy.
AT LAST I UNDERSTAND doxa as ikon not veil

Plotinus' concentric rings of emanation explains it. Here there is atomization, causation, etc. There, unity exists. Structure -organization- is pure, which is to say, these beings are in a sense incorporeal (yet in another sense they are not; but here, we see not the total being as a unity but rather discrete physical components that add up to nothing.
uncertainty_flags: Identity of the contact: PKD claims 5D entities are 'Gods' of Egypt, India, Greece, but their specific nature remains unexplained. Are they identical with VALIS or plural?
The Xerox missive incident (3-74): context is unclear—what was the missive, how did 5D intervention save PKD, and what was at stake?
The phosphene graphics: PKD claims they were language but admits not remembering the sequences. How can he verify meaning if the content is forgotten?
Status of King Felix cypher: is it a symbol, a sentient entity, or a message encoded in perceptions? Its role is suggestive rather than explained.
Coaxiality definition: PKD says the meta-abstraction 'ushered in' understanding of coaxiality, but the precise mechanism remains elusive.
90-second contact vs. 60-second contact: the text mentions both timeframes without clarifying if they are separate events or the same one.
Work identification: 'TEARS' may refer to The Tears of Albion or another work; 'BTA' identity (context: Tagore vision) unclear.
reading_excerpt: My God: This is all the case!
